Kate Bitar
A teacher at Newton College who co-leads the Autosportklas alongside Bernardo Marelis.<SEP>Kate Bitar is an individual involved with the autosportklas trajectory, facing challenges related to its setup, financing, or student recruitment.<SEP>A teacher at Newton College who leads the Autosportklas and highlights the financial challenges of maintaining the program.

Autosportklas
An elite, year-long practical track at Newton College focusing on race car maintenance and competition weekends.<SEP>Autosportklas is a specialized educational and training trajectory focused on motorsport, offered at Newton College.<SEP>A highly selective, practical automotive racing class for excellent technical students, also referred to as the raceklas.

Hussam
An 18-year-old student who upgraded his education level to qualify for the Autosportklas.

Abel
A 17-year-old student participating in the Autosportklas who aspires to work in the racing industry.

Lauren Ramos
Lauren Ramos is the education manager of the autosportklas who aims to make structural improvements to the training trajectory.<SEP>The training manager of Sector Techniek & Vormgeving who seeks to expand and develop the Autosportklas program.

Defensie
The Dutch Ministry of Defense, which is a potential career path for technical students.

Bernardo Marelis
A teacher at Newton College who co-leads the Autosportklas.<SEP>Bernardo Marelis is an individual associated with the autosportklas who shares insights on what makes the program educational.<SEP>A teacher at Newton College who leads the Autosportklas alongside Kate Bitar.

Newton College
An educational institution that offers a specialized autosport class for top automotive engineering students.<SEP>Newton College is an educational institution that hosts the autosportklas program.<SEP>The school that hosts, partially funds, and uses the Autosportklas as its promotional showcase.

Sector Techniek & Vormgeving
The technical and design educational department managed by Lauren Ramos.

Opleiding Motorvoertuigentechniek
The vocational automotive engineering program that hosts the specialized Autosportklas.<SEP>The standard motor vehicle technology curriculum where Autosportklas students reintegrate after their racing year.

Keulen
Cologne, a German city where Autosportklas students go on excursions to the motor exhibition.

Parijs-Dakar
The Paris-Dakar rally, an international off-road motorsport race for which Proflex supplies parts.

Engeland
England, visited by students for educational excursions to major racing brands and home to Europe's only higher vocational race mechanic program.

Tilburg
A Dutch city where an autosport class has been operating since 1988.<SEP>The city where guest lectures from industry specialists are hosted.

Proflex
A manufacturing company specializing in shock absorbers that hosts student excursions and provides guest lectures.

M-Sport
A prominent motorsport brand and team visited by Autosportklas students during their educational excursions to England.

Prodrive
An advanced motorsport and engineering group known for building Le Mans race cars, visited by Autosportklas students during their trips to England.

Sponsors
External financial contributors upon whom the Autosportklas racing team relies for funding and continued operation.

Arda
Arda is an advisory consultancy firm that conducted a major labor market study among 1,200 job seekers.

Vera Tames
Vera Tames is a representative of the senior employment agency Plustalent who discusses the motivations of older job seekers.

Ministerie van Defensie
The Dutch Ministry of Defence, which provides racing cars to Newton College to promote technical careers.<SEP>The Dutch Ministry of Defence, which collaborates with Newton College by providing resources, training, or employment support for the autosportklas.

Samir van Veen
Samir van Veen is a researcher at Arda who investigated generational differences in job seekers' preferences.

Arbeidsmarktonderzoek
Arbeidsmarktonderzoek is a labor market study conducted by Arda to analyze what job seekers of different ages find important in a career.

Plustalent
Plustalent is a specialized temporary employment agency for older workers.

Marcia Bregman
Marcia Bregman is a representative of the trade union FNV who comments on the labor market anxieties experienced by younger people.

FNV
FNV is a prominent Dutch trade union represented by Marcia Bregman.

Youth Job Seekers
Job seekers under 24 years of age who prioritize stability, physical activity, and financial rewards over work content or creativity due to anxieties about the future.

Older Job Seekers
Job seekers aged 45 and older who seek challenging work, creativity, analysis, and concrete results, often supported by an established financial foundation.

Top 5 Job Desires
A ranked list illustrating the top five distinct workplace preferences for both young job seekers under 24 and older job seekers starting at age 45.

Newspaper Article
A news publication detailing the contrasting job desires and priorities of younger and older work seekers on the labor market.

BBL Training
BBL Training (beroepsbegeleidend leren) is a vocational training program for bakers that combines school-based learning with practical work experience.

Marke
Marke is a bakery organization that offers various employment, training, and career progression opportunities across its different business units.<SEP>A brand and organization that operates multiple retail branches and sells baked goods produced by its own network of bakeries.

Joshua
Joshua is an individual mentioned in the text's questions who is interested in working in the decentralized bakery.

Piet
Piet is a job seeker looking for a position within the bakery organization.

Exhibition Stand
An exhibition stand is a rented and decorated space at a trade fair used by businesses as a calling card to attract and engage potential clients.

Routing
Routing refers to the planned directional pathing that guides visitors logically through the different areas of an exhibition stand.

Island Stand
An island stand is a detached type of exhibition stand surrounded by walkways, offering the greatest flexibility in design but at a higher cost.

Stand Builder
A stand builder is a specialized business that can be hired to design and construct professional exhibition stands.

Trade Fair
An event where business providers rent space from an organizer to set up exhibition stands and showcase products.

Lighting
Lighting is an essential design element in an exhibition stand used to attract visitors and highlight specific products or areas.

Inline Stand
A basic type of exhibition stand situated in a row of stands, offering fewer design possibilities.

Exhibition Organizer
The entity that organizes the trade fair, rents out space to exhibitors, and coordinates stand locations.

End-of-Row Stand
A type of exhibition stand positioned across a row, offering multiple layout opportunities.

Corner Stand
A type of exhibition stand located at the end of a row, offering more layout possibilities than an inline stand.

Sitting Area
A designated zone within an exhibition stand meant for hosting visitors, providing seating, materials, or child-friendly spaces.

CAO
Collectieve Arbeidsovereenkomst (Collective Labor Agreement), which regulates employment terms such as waiting days and sick pay percentages.

Alette
Alette is an entrepreneur planning to sell earrings in a booth at a trade show.

Ziekteverzuim
Sickness absence, where an employee cannot perform duties due to medical reasons.

Kortdurend Ziekteverzuim
Short-term sickness absence, which is temporary and usually represents a limited financial risk for the employer.

Wet Verbetering Poortwachter
A Dutch law that requires employers and long-term sick employees to jointly create a rehabilitation plan.

Frequent Kortdurend Ziekteverzuim
Frequent short-term sickness absence, often caused by underlying work or personal issues, which can lead to long-term sickness.

Langdurend Ziekteverzuim
Long-term sickness absence, defined as being ill for six weeks or longer, which triggers significant employer obligations.

Re-integratietraject
A reintegration process designed to help long-term sick employees return to work, paid for by the employer.<SEP>A vocational reintegration process initiated to help an employee return to work after an extended period of absence.

Ziekteverzuimverzekering
Sickness absence insurance that helps employers cover the costs of continuing to pay sick employees' wages.

WIA
The Dutch Work and Income according to Labour Capacity Act, which employees enter if long-term sickness rehabilitation fails.<SEP>The Dutch Work and Income according to Labour Capacity Act, under which employee guidance and support may be offered.

Arbodienst
An occupational health and safety service that assists employers with employee absenteeism guidance and prevention.<SEP>An occupational health service in the Netherlands that helps employers prevent and manage employee absenteeism.

Beursstand
An exhibition booth used by companies to present and sell products, requiring strategic planning in layout, lighting, and routing.

Eilandstand
An island stand; a type of exhibition booth that allows for the greatest variation and flexibility in interior design and layout.

Hoekstand
A corner stand; a specific layout variation of an exhibition booth.

Tussenstand
An intermediate or row stand; a specific layout variation of an exhibition booth.

Kopstand
A head stand; a specific layout variation of an exhibition booth.

Verlichting
Lighting used in an exhibition booth, which should accurately display colors and highlight products.

Ondernemer
The entrepreneur or business owner who bears the financial risks and management responsibilities associated with employee absenteeism.

Werknemer
The employee whose presence and health directly affect business operations and who may occasionally absent themselves.

Bedrijfsarts
A company doctor who assesses sick employees, handles official sickness reports, and guides the reintegration process.<SEP>The occupational physician or company doctor to whom employee sickness must be reported.

Grijs Verzuim
Ambiguous absenteeism where an employee has mild symptoms but could work, yet decides to report sick.

Ongeoorloofd Verzuim
Unauthorized absence where an employee fails to show up for work without permission or valid notification.<SEP>Unauthorized absence, also known as 'black' absence, where an employee fails to show up for work without permission or notification.

Verzuimverzekering
Absenteeism insurance that covers wage payments during sick leave and provides advice on preventing absenteeism.

Zwart Verzuim
Fictitious or fraudulent absenteeism where an employee falsely reports sick.

Wit Verzuim
Legitimate absenteeism where an employee is genuinely unable to work due to sickness.

Werkstress
Work-related stress, which is identified as a potential cause for employees regularly reporting sick.

Technisch Specialist Niveau 4
The specific level 4 technical specialist track within the automotive engineering program whose top students qualify for the Autosportklas.

Sportongeval
A sports injury that prevents an employee from working, which must be handled as a standard sick leave event by the employer.

Geen Arbeid, Geen Loon
The Dutch legal principle of 'no work, no pay' which allows employers to withhold salary when an employee fails to work without authorization.

Verzuim
General employee absenteeism or sick leave from work.

Employers
A category of individuals (werkgevers) mentioned in the test options as potential beneficiaries of the research results.

Job Seekers
A category of individuals (werkzoekenden) mentioned in the test options as potential beneficiaries of the research results.

Employees
A category of individuals (werknemers) mentioned in the test options as potential beneficiaries of the research results.

Oefentoets Lezen B1-1
A practice reading test designed to assess intermediate Dutch language reading comprehension.

Research Results
The outcomes of a study referenced in the first practice test question.

Four-Step Reading Method
A systematic reading strategy involving skimming titles, reading questions, identifying keywords, and verifying answers in context.

B1 Reading Comprehension
The target language proficiency level for the practice test, focusing on intermediate-level reading skills.

Dictionary
A reference tool (woordenboek) that test-takers can use to look up unknown words during the practice test.

Test-Taker
The individual who completes the reading test and evaluates their performance through the post-test questionnaire.

Referral Words
Grammatical markers such as 'die', 'dat', 'daar', or 'zij' that test-takers are advised to observe closely when verifying answers.

Keywords
Core words identified within the questions and answers to aid in locating correct passages.

Time Allocation
The strategic distribution of time across different parts of the reading test.

Utrecht
The city in the Netherlands that hosts the main office, the central bakery, and one of the six decentralized bakeries of the organization.

Proefbakkerij
The experimental test bakery department in Utrecht where creative staff develop new products, flavors, and recipes.

Central Bakery Utrecht
The primary, industrial-scale bakery of the organization located in Utrecht, serving as the central production hub that creates bases for all kinds of pastries.

Decentralized Bakeries
A network of six regional bakeries across the country that prepare, finish, and deliver daily pastry orders directly to local Marke branches.

Operations Office
The planning and process management department (Bedrijfsbureau) in Utrecht that handles scheduling, system maintenance, and process optimization.

Purchasing Department
The administrative department (Afdeling Inkoop) in Utrecht responsible for sourcing ingredients and packaging materials for the bakeries.

Quality Department
The department (Afdeling Kwaliteit) in Utrecht responsible for monitoring hygiene and maintaining quality standards across all bakeries.

Administration Department
The office (Afdeling Administratie) in Utrecht responsible for maintaining structured organizational and financial records.

Human Resources Department
The personnel department (Afdeling Personeelszaken) in Utrecht responsible for managing staff recruitment, development, and personnel matters.

data.entity_name: Van Dale Pocketwoordenboek Nederlands als Tweede Taal
data.content:
Van Dale Pocketwoordenboek Nederlands als Tweede Taal
A physical Dutch-as-a-second-language pocket dictionary allowed for use during B1-level reading examinations.

BBL-opleiding
A vocational work-study training program for bakers that can be combined with employment at the organization's bakeries.

Oefentoets Lezen B1
A practice reading comprehension test for Dutch language level B1, designed to take 65 minutes.

Staatsexamen I
A Dutch national state examination on which the B1 reading practice test is based.

Bakery Management
The executive board (bakkerijdirectie) that controls the bakery organization from the Utrecht office.

Korstgebak Department
The specialized puff pastry department within the Central Bakery Utrecht where products like sausage rolls are made.

Uitzetkoeling
The designated cooling and sorting zone in decentralized bakeries where finished pastries are organized before transport.

Deegafdeling
The dough department within the Central Bakery Utrecht responsible for preparing dough-based items like apple pies.

Beslagafdeling
The batter department within the Central Bakery Utrecht that prepares bases for products such as photo cakes.
